title: Recommendation Inspector: granular diff previews, safe apply & audit timeline for Optimize
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Deliver a unified "Recommendation Inspector" experience in the Optimize console that surfaces batching and caching recommendations with an explicit diff preview, a safe apply workflow with canary and rollback controls, and a forensic audit trail. This ticket scopes the PM work: requirements, acceptance criteria, open trade-offs, partner handoffs (Design & Eng), and rollout strategy. Goals: 1) increase safe apply velocity for customers by 30% by offering explainable diffs and previews, 2) reduce failed apply incidents by 50% via canary/apply validation and automated rollback hooks, 3) ensure auditability for compliance and incident investigations.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation card displays one-line summary, cost delta estimate, confidence score, and predicate tags (batching|caching|quantization) with expandable inspector
Diff preview pane shows before/after config with tokenized and human-friendly change highlights and an estimated token/time cost delta
Safe apply flow supports: dry-run validation, canary rollout (percentage + time window), immediate rollback, and manual approval gates
Audit timeline records: who applied, which model/version, pre/post snapshots, canary results, automated rollbacks with timestamps, and free-text operator annotations
Console exposes an immutable changelog export (CSV/JSON) scoped to a project and time range
Design and Eng sign-offs completed and E2E test plan passes (smoke + canary simulation)
notes: Trade-offs considered: inline inline-diff vs separate full-screen inspector (chose inspector to preserve card density and enable side-by-side before/after comparisons)
Privacy: do not surface customer prompt tokens in plain text in audit exports; show redacted previews with token counts unless KMS permission granted
Performance: diff rendering must be async for large config objects; will show streaming skeleton then full diff
Rollout plan: beta for Dedicated customers first (opt-in), then Hosted tenants with admin opt-in via feature flag
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): opt-in for Dedicated customers and internal tenants, telemetry enabled for success/failure rates. Phase 2: gradual enable for Hosted with feature flag gated by usage and compliance checks. Phase 3: GA with export hooks and retention settings. Rollback strategy: feature flag toggle + safe-mode endpoint to freeze applies.
qa_checks: E2E tests simulate canary success/failure and confirm automated rollback triggers
Manual exploratory session with SRE to validate cost calc accuracy under variable token rates
Audit export validation for schema, redaction rules, and pagination
